subject: maths
question: The marked price of an article is ₹550. It is sold for ₹317.90, after giving three successive discounts of 15%, x% and 20% on its marked price. If it is sold by giving a single discount of 2 x %. then its selling price (in ₹) will be:
solution:
**Given: **

Marked Price = Rs. 550

Selling price = Rs. 317.90

Successive discount (1) = 15%

Successive discount (2) = x%

Successive discount (3) = 20%

Single discount = 2x%

**Formula Used:**

Selling price = Marked price × (100 - Discount%)/(100) 

**Calculation:**

Case:1

317.9 = 550 × ((100 - 15))/(100) × ((100 - x))/(100) × ((100 - 20))/(100) 

By cross multiplication:

⇒ 5610 = 374x

⇒ x = 15

Case:2

Single discunt = 2x% = 2 × 15 = 30%

Cost price = Rs. 550

⇒ Selling price = 550 - 30% of 550

⇒ Selling price = 385

**∴ Its selling price is Rs. 385**
